title: League of Legends Team Voice could transform Solo Queue forever… with one condition
summary: League of Legends Team Voice could transform Solo Queue forever… with one condition  Esports Insider
content:
Davide Xu is a freelance writer at Esports Insider focused on League of Legends esports. He covers everything inside and outside the Rift—especially when it comes to European and Asian competitive scenes. With a finance background and a multicultural lens, he loves talking about business as much as macro.

Olivia Richman is a seasoned esports journalist who has worked with Inven Global, Esports Illustrated, Esports.gg, and more. As an editor and writer at Esports Insider, she loves telling unique esports stories, especially within the FGC. When not working and gaming, Olivia loves collecting Kirby plush, eating sushi, and driving her cars at the track.

For 17 years,League of Legendshas asked players to coordinate in-game solely on pings and hurried messages typed in between clicks. Now, this could all change.

Earlier this March,Riot Games confirmedthat it was exploring the implementation of Team Voice to the game, extending communication beyond premade parties.

While the feature hasn’t been released just yet,recent leaksalso reported that the dev team is working on a Voicemod integration, meaning that players can alter their natural voices to disguise themselves.

On paper, this is an important addition, as it would reduce potential harm caused by discriminatory behavior. That said, it still won’t address the underlying issue: the potential toxicity that comes with such a powerful tool.
